lessons_used: Evidence is still thin for adoption (new_screen, redesign) and sign_in (reorder) changes because only one test has been completed for each.
Evidence is still thin for finish, new_screen changes because the two completed tests disagreed on outcome.
Predictions were consistently too high across all tests.

candidates.title: Post-Adoption Account Authentication Shift
candidates.change: Move the sign-in prompt to appear after pet selection and certificate creation rather than before friend selection.
candidates.why: Sign-in causes a 27.1% drop early in onboarding; moving it after pet selection leverages user investment before asking for credentials.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in after adoption certificate is explicitly permitted by rules 1 and 4.

candidates.score_note: Target step loses 27.1% of users. Evidence relies on funnel data without direct support mail backing. Single previous test yielded +0.7%.

candidates.title: Two Column Split Friend Picker Layout
candidates.change: Rebuild the pet selection screen into a split two-column layout with animated pet previews alongside choice cards.
candidates.why: Adoption is the lowest converting onboarding step at 60.9%, with high median duration (89s) indicating confusion when selecting a friend.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Desktop Companion
pick_friend.body: Select the pet personality that best fits your workflow and desktop environment.

guard.reason: Redesigning the pet selection screen layout while maintaining its core selection job is allowed under rule 2.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has the lowest conversion (60.9%), making impact potential highest. Evidence thin on redesigns; single previous test showed +0.4%.

candidates.title: Pet Interaction Quick Start Tips Screen
candidates.change: Insert a dedicated quick tips screen right before the final home screen outlining key desktop controls and interaction hotkeys.
candidates.why: Support received multiple tickets regarding post-onboarding confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet.

new_pet_commands.headline: Essential Desktop Pet Controls
new_pet_commands.body: Quick tips to interact with your pet anytime during your work day.

guard.reason: Inserting a new tips screen before the home intro is allowed under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from support tickets and duration, but adding new screens to finish step previously yielded negative relative change (-0.5%).

candidates.title: Desktop Visibility Status Check Flow
candidates.change: Introduce an active desktop overlay status verification and readiness notification flow during the waiting phase.
candidates.why: Three support tickets reported pets failing to appear on the desktop or app startup issues, while the waiting step has high mean time.

waiting.headline: Preparing Desktop Companion
waiting.body: Verifying desktop overlay rendering permissions and activating companion graphics.

guard.reason: Adding overlay check and wait notifications to the waiting screen is permitted under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Both support tickets and high mean wait duration point to friction during home setup, though implementing a new flow requires custom development.

candidates.title: Account Persistence and Multi-Pet Warning Hint
candidates.change: Add an explicit hint on the sign-in screen clarifying how signing into an existing account recovers previously adopted pets.
candidates.why: Eight support emails—the largest issue group—reported pets being reset or missing after signing in with different credentials.

sign_in.hint: Use your primary account email to automatically sync existing pets and save state across devices.

guard.reason: text in 'sign_in.hint' asks for or mentions personal data

candidates.title: Companion Welcome Gift Banner
candidates.change: Display a visual welcome badge on the adoption certificate screen offering bonus starter treats upon finishing naming.
candidates.why: Adoption suffers from a sharp dropoff (60.9% conversion); adding a clear reward incentive encourages users to complete adoption.

adoption_certificate.headline: Name Your Companion & Claim Welcome Kit

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions bonus treats and a welcome kit, violating the prohibition on mentioning gifts, bonuses, or free extras in Rule 3.

candidates.title: Generation Progress Tip Carousel
candidates.change: Add an informative tip carousel component to the waiting screen to engage users while pet assets generate.
candidates.why: The waiting screen has a high median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s, leading to drop-offs while waiting for pet creation.

components.text: Tip: Double-click your pet on the desktop anytime to start a short break timer!

guard.reason: Adding a tip carousel component to the waiting screen is allowed under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: High wait time (201s median) offers solid opportunity to retain users via in-place info component at moderate cost.

candidates.title: Story Scroll Intro Journey Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the initial story screen into a smooth story scroll layout introducing companion benefits before path selection.
candidates.why: The choose path step drops 23.8% of users with a high mean time of 514s, showing early friction before path commitment.

story.headline: Welcome to Desktop Sanctuary
story.body: Discover how a desktop companion keeps you company and boosts productivity throughout your workday.

guard.reason: Redesigning the story screen layout while still introducing the desktop companion is permitted under rule 2.

candidates.score_note: Initial step drops 23.8% of traffic with high mean duration, but evidence comes solely from funnel data.

candidates.title: Desktop Control Shortcut Toast Notification
candidates.change: Add a notification badge component on the home intro screen displaying hotkeys for summoning pet controls.
candidates.why: Users spend a median 395s on finish and support tickets highlight post-onboarding confusion regarding pet controls.

components.text: Shortcut: Press Alt+P (Option+P on macOS) anytime to open pet controls on desktop.

guard.reason: Adding a hotkey shortcut notification text component to home_intro is allowed under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Strong alignment between support tickets and finish duration; toast notification avoids adding an extra step.

candidates.title: Compact Pet Photo Upload Screen
candidates.change: Change the upload photo screen to a compact layout with clear formatting guidance for photo selection.
candidates.why: Three support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or bad visual output when uploading custom pet photos.

upload_photos.headline: Upload Pet Photo Guidelines
upload_photos.body: For best results, upload a clear front-facing photo of your pet with good lighting and clear contrast.

guard.reason: Redesigning the photo upload screen layout with updated guidelines maintains its core job and is allowed under rule 2.

candidates.score_note: Targets the lowest-converting step (60.9%) backed by explicit support tickets regarding upload failures.

held_by_harm_budget: Two Column Split Friend Picker Layout
lessons_next: Evidence is still thin for adoption (new_screen, redesign), home (new_flow), and sign_in (reorder) changes because only one test has been completed for each.
Evidence is still thin for finish (new_screen) changes because the two completed tests disagreed on outcome.
Predictions were consistently too high across tests.
